text:
Elena (Design): posting a quick design check for API keys UX. focused on rotate/revoke flows, copy clarity, and accessibility. mock: https://redwood/drive/keys-ux-v4.png. Can people skim? :eyes:
Jorge (PM): main goals: reduce anxiety during rotate, make revoke recoverable (soft revoke), and surface scope early at creation. Also need distinct copy for embedding-only keys vs full access keys.
Sam (Engineering): constraints: we only issue the plaintext secret once at create. After that we can show masked `••••1234`. We can support soft-revoke (deactivate + ttl) and a grace-period rotation mode.
Elena (Design): UX idea: after create, show a temporary callout/drawer with the plaintext key, a big primary `Save this key` and a small required checkbox for admin-level keys: `I have securely stored this key.` The drawer auto-closes after confirmation.
Priya (A11y): a11y bits: drawer must trap focus, initial focus on heading, ESC closes it. Copy action should trigger a live region reading `API key copied to clipboard`. Avoid color-only warnings. Provide `role=alert` for irreversible warnings.
Ivy (Security): security note: we should include copy that reminds users to rotate keys on a schedule for admin scopes. Also recommend embedding-only keys for vector workloads.
Elena (Design): rotate modal options: immediate rotate (old key invalid immediately) vs grace rotate (old key valid for X hours). UI shows estimated impacted services: `~N services (best-effort)` with an action `Run deeper scan` that kicks off an async job.
Sam (Engineering): we can return a best-effort estimate based on last-30-days logs. Deep scan sends a notification when complete. We'll expose `recently_created`, `deactivated_until`, and `last_used_at` flags for UI.
Jorge (PM): copy suggestions: primary rotate CTA `Rotate and reveal` with small subtext `New key shown only once; save it now.` For revoke actions use `Temporarily deactivate` vs `Permanently revoke` to avoid ambiguity.
Priya (A11y): agree on verb clarity. For revoke, `Temporarily deactivate` should include an accessible description: `Deactivated keys can be reactivated within 24 hours.` Ensure toast messages use `role=status` for screen readers.
Elena (Design): empty state copy: `No keys yet — create a key to get started.` CTA label: `Create key`. Small tip under CTA: `Tip: use embedding-only keys for vector workloads to reduce blast radius.`
Ivy (Security): UI should also show a small `risk` badge (Low/Medium/High) computed server-side for each key. That helps customers prioritize rotation.
Sam (Engineering): we'll add `risk_score` numeric and `risk_label` for display. Also audit logs will record `created_from=console|api` and `rotation_mode` for analytics.
Elena (Design): table affordances: show name, scope badge, last used, risk badge, and overflow menu. For newly-created rows render a transient reveal icon for 10s to copy the full key. Otherwise show masked secret.
Priya (A11y): reveal control must be keyboard-focusable and announce `Full key available for 10 seconds`. Do not rely on hover.
Jorge (PM): order of overflow: Rotate, Temporarily deactivate, Permanently revoke, Edit metadata. For enterprise customers expose `keep old key active` toggle during rotate.
Sam (Engineering): note: `keep old key active` requires special backend support (grace mode). We'll gate it by customer tier on the endpoint.
Elena (Design): small copy question: label for unused keys older than 90 days. Options: `Inactive`, `No recent usage`, `Not used recently`. Preference?
Priya (A11y): `No recent usage` is explicit and less likely to be misread as disabled. Provide tooltip `No requests in last 90 days.`
Ivy (Security): prefer `No recent usage` too. Also recommend an automated cleanup suggestion: `Consider deactivating unused keys`.
Elena (Design): I'll update mocks to include the reveal drawer, rotate modal with checklist, soft-revoke banner (`Temporarily deactivated — Reactivate within 24h`), and risk badges. Will post updated link in ~2 hours.
